entity_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under IdentifyPartnershipEstateTrGrp matches the entity name shown at the top of the form; only line 1 is needed for the primary name.

ein.rationale: EIN under IdentifyPartnershipEstateTrGrp directly corresponds to the Employer Identification Number field at the top of the form.

properties.rationale: Blueprint declares a single array covering all property columns A–H, but the canonical schema splits this into repeated RentalAddressGrp and RentalIncomeExpensesGrp elements per property — blueprint should be refactored into individual per-property objects each containing address, fair rental days, personal use days, gross rents, and all expense line items aligned to the canonical groups.

total_rental_real_estate_income.rationale: TotalRentalRealEstateIncomeAmt at the form root matches Line 20a total rental real estate income summed across all properties.

total_rental_real_estate_expenses.rationale: TotalExpensesAmt at the form root (xpath TotalExpensesAmt, idx 34) matches Line 20b total rental real estate expenses across all properties, as distinct from the per-property TotalExpensesAmt inside RentalIncomeExpensesGrp.

net_gain_loss_form_4797.rationale: NetGainLossFrom4797Amt directly matches Line 21 net gain (loss) from Form 4797.

net_income_loss_from_partnerships.rationale: NetIncomeLossAmt at the form root is the closest match for Line 22a net income (loss) from rental real estate activities from partnerships/estates/trusts, though the name is somewhat generic.

net_rental_real_estate_income_loss.rationale: RealEstateNetIncomeLossAmt matches Line 23 net rental real estate income (loss) combined result entered on Schedule K.
